question.text: A crystal is made up of metal ions <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>'</mo><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>'</mo></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>'</mo><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>'</mo></math> and oxide ions. Oxide ions form a ccp lattice structure. The cation <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>'</mo><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>'</mo></math> occupies <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>50</mn><mo>%</mo></math> of octahedral voids and the cation <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>'</mo><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>'</mo></math> occupies <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>12</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>5</mn><mo> </mo><mo>%</mo></math> of tetrahedral voids of oxide lattice. The oxidation numbers of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>'</mo><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>'</mo></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>'</mo><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>'</mo></math> are respectively :

solution.text:
In the ccp latice of oxide ions effective number of O-2ions =8×18+6×12=4

In the ccp latice,

No. of octahedral voids =4

No. of tetrahedrla voids =8

Given M1 atoms occupies 50% of octahedral voids and M2 atoms occupies 12.5 of tetrahederal voids

No. of M1 metal atoms =4×50100=2

No. of M2 metal atoms =8×12.5100=1

∴ Formula of the compound =M12M2O4

∴ Oxidation states of metals M1 & M2 respectively are +2 and +4
